scripts.lint: uv run --locked ruff check . && pnpm run lint:imports && pnpm run lint:boundaries
scripts.lint:imports: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked lint-imports --config backend/pyproject.toml
scripts.check: uv run --locked ruff check --fix . && uv run --locked ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml -p backend
scripts.build-data: cd .. && uv run --project backend --locked python -m backend.infrastructure.cli.structure_pmda_xml --source-dir data/pmda/originals --register
